description: The full, sourced record for one id from search: "country:panama" (summary plus every topic: visas, citizenship, tax, banking, property and inheritance tax, cost of living, safety, healthcare, passport, military service, firearms, renunciation, citizenship by descent, tax blacklists), "program:panama-pensionado" (requirements, minimums, stay rules, timelines, fees, legal citations), "city:mexico/merida", "club:…", "golf:…", "project:…", "event:…", "service:…", "bloc:mercosur" (settlement agreement), "jurisdiction:Cayman Islands" (tax blacklist status) or "about" (data coverage and citation terms). A bare country or program name also works.

id.description: An id from search, e.g. "country:costa-rica" or "program:panama-friendly-nations-visa"; or a country or program name.

topics.description: For a country: only these topics, because a full country record can be large. Omit for everything.

name: fetch
title: Fetch a complete record
